## 🌡️ Temperature
- **Germination:** 20-25°C

## 💧 Hydrometry Rate
- **Soil Moisture:** 40-60%

## ☀️ Sunshine Rate
- **Light:** 6-8 hrs

## 🌧️ Rainfall
- **Annual:** 500-800 mm

## 💦 Humidity Rate
- **Air Humidity:** 40-70%

## 🌱 Soil Type
- **Soil:** Well-drained
